  • Made from 100% polyester, 150gsm - 4.42oz SPF Protected Jersey Mesh Material
  • Athletic Stretch, Breathable, and moisture wicking fabric.

Great for short recreational rides or long distance treks there is ample storage to hold your phone keys, extra water bottles and other essentials.
